title: Access traffic steering, switching and splitting (ATSSS)

entities.name: ATSSS feature
entities.description: Optional feature enabling multi-access PDU connectivity service using both 3GPP and non-3GPP access networks simultaneously. Provides traffic steering, switching and splitting capabilities.

entities.name: Multi-access PDU session
entities.description: PDU session that can have user-plane resources on two access networks (3GPP and non-3GPP), enabling multi-access PDU connectivity service.

entities.name: Multi-access PDU connectivity service
entities.description: Service that exchanges PDUs between UE and data network by simultaneously using one 3GPP access network and one non-3GPP access network.

entities.name: UE ATSSS capability
entities.description: UE's ability to support the optional ATSSS feature for multi-access connectivity.

entities.name: CIoT 5GS optimization exclusion
entities.description: MA PDU session is not applicable for CIoT 5GS optimization in this release of specification.

entities.name: Dual access registration
entities.description: UE registered via both 3GPP and non-3GPP accesses, enabling MA PDU session establishment.

entities.name: Single access registration
entities.description: UE registered via one access only, still allowing MA PDU session request.

relations.description: ATSSS feature enables the multi-access PDU connectivity service
Multi-access PDU connectivity service is realized by establishing a multi-access PDU session
MA PDU session is not applicable for CIoT 5GS optimization
UE can request MA PDU session when registered via both accesses
UE can request MA PDU session when registered via one access only
ATSSS feature may be supported by the UE and the 5GCN
